milestone.title: raul TUI — Tab lane nav, detail document polish, chrome consistency

intent.outcome: raul navigates between lanes with Tab / Shift+Tab; arrows always move within the active lane's content; the 'tab bar focused vs content focused' toggle is gone. The window title renders 'Review, Approve, Understand Layers' (RAUL's L stands for 'Layers'). The milestone detail view renders every field of the milestone document in a polished, markdown-ish layout — meta sub-block with all overlays, new sections (Design Decisions, Open Questions, Work Packages, Verification, Delta), enriched Steps / ACs / Findings context lines, ratatui-native widgets (LineGauge for progress bars, ratatui::widgets::Tabs for the lane bar, List::highlight_style and Table::highlight_style for selection chrome), and a chrome-consistency pass that drops the 'floating' help/settings overlay treatment in favor of the same borders used elsewhere. Tabs gain detail-section navigation ([/] jumps to next/prev section, n/p jumps to next/prev item).

problem.description: raul's Tab key toggles a focus state that doesn't earn its keep — Left/Right already pre-loads lane data on the tab bar, so the only useful action there is lane navigation, and the toggle is two keypresses for no net effect (Esc-from-list bounces the user to a state they don't need). The window title's 'Lanes' is a misleading synonym for mp's internal `Lane` vocabulary and 'Layers' matches the visual mental model while preserving the RAUL acronym. The milestone detail scrollbar miscomputes `max_scroll` from `lines.len()` instead of post-wrap rendered rows, so wrapped content can't be scrolled to its actual bottom (symptom: 'no scrollbar when needed' / 'doesn't show everything'). The detail view buries fields that the data model carries — Design Decisions, Open Questions, Work Packages, Verification, Delta, meta overlays, and the rich per-step / per-finding evidence (files, tests, done_when, fixed_in, anchor, thread, tags, claims) all live in JSON but never on screen. Several TUI overlays (help, settings) use a 'floating' chrome (`BorderType::Double` + `bg(Color::DarkGray)`) that visually differs from the rest of the TUI, and several hand-rolled Span / Row selections shadow the ratatui-native `List::highlight_style` / `Table::highlight_style` paths.

in_scope: Default keybinds: Tab → next_lane, Shift+Tab → previous_lane (added to the existing multi-binding defaults; Left/Right/h/l keep working as aliases).

Remove `Keybinds::toggle_tab_focus` slot, `Action::ToggleTabFocus` variant, and `app.tab_bar_focused` field — plus every reader / writer / conditional branch (runner, chrome, dashboard_view, footer, settings modal, help overlay generation).
Esc on a top-level list becomes a no-op; Esc on a drilled-in detail still pops back to its list (M-action::Esc resolution unchanged).

Window title: 'Review, Approve, Understand Lanes - R.A.U.L.' → 'Review, Approve, Understand Layers - R.A.U.L.' (1 string in `crates/raul/src/tui/render/mod.rs`; tests asserting the title updated in lockstep).

Milestone detail scrollbar fix: replace `lines.len()`-based `detail_max_scroll` set with a measurement pass — render the Paragraph into a same-sized `Buffer`, scan bottom-up for the last non-blank row, use the result as effective content height for the scrollbar thumb math (`measure_paragraph_height` helper in `tui/render/scrollbar.rs` or a new `tui/render/detail_scrollbar.rs`).

Detail-section navigation keybinds: `next_section` (default `]`), `prev_section` (default `[`), `next_item` (default `n`), `prev_item` (default `p`) — added as four new `Keybinds` slots; handlers in `modes/normal.rs` match them only when `app.content == ContentState::MilestoneDetail`.
Milestone detail rendering overhaul in `crates/raul/src/tui/render/milestone_detail.rs`:
• meta sub-block: effort, risk, change_kind, priority, depends_on, created, updated

• overlay rendering: blocked (block_reason + blocked_by + blocked_at), cancelled, deferred (deferred_reason), needs_regrooming, target_version, executed_by, remediation_pre_state, G14 approval-blocked indicator preserved

• new sections rendered only when present: Design Decisions (area / choice / rationale), Open Questions (id / question / status / answer), Work Packages (id / name / goal / rollback), Verification (date / branch / evidence), Delta (only when change_kind == 'delta' — Added / Modified / Removed sub-lists with base_version)

• enriched Steps rendering: 2-line per item — header (badge · id — action) + context lines (files · tests · done_when · claim: who · when · lease) — wp: WP1 tag on rows whose `work_package` field is set; steps rendered FLAT (no nesting under WPs)
• enriched Acceptance Criteria rendering: badge · id — description + verification · evidence context lines

• enriched Findings rendering: sorted open-first by severity, per item 2-line (header + context for category · author @ created · fixed_in · anchor.path:line · thread: N · tags · summary · phase · unfixed if open with no fixed_in)

• markdown-ish grammar: section headers emitted as `##  ✦  Title  (count)  ──` parsed through the existing `markdown::parse_markdown`, all section headers use the same grammar; empty sections render no header and no placeholder

Progress bar rendered via `ratatui::widgets::LineGauge` (replaces the homerolled `[▓░░]` string from `compute_progress_bar`), `filled_style` / `unfilled_style` derived from `app.effective_palette()` and the user's `ui.icons` mode (Unicode / Ascii / None → accent / accent+ASCII / dim).

Lane tab bar rendered via `ratatui::widgets::Tabs`; `compute_tab_bar_layout` and `tab_hit_test_for_layout` in `view_state.rs` stay (hit-test unchanged), only the renderer is rewritten — visual output identical for terminals at width ≥ 60, identical overflow / indicator / ellipsis behavior on narrow widths.

Selection-chrome consolidation: drop the per-item `is_selected ? fg=Black, bg=accent, bold` styling inside `List::new(...)` items in Settings, Review Menu, Annotation Thread — use `List::highlight_style(...)` as the single source of truth for selection. Same treatment for `Table::highlight_style` in Milestones and Backlog lists — drop the dual per-row selection styling inside the render loop.

Overlay chrome consistency pass: drop the `bg(Color::DarkGray)` fill and `BorderType::Double` from Help and Settings overlays; use the standard `Borders::ALL`, no fill, matching the milestone-detail block style — no more 'floating' treatment.
Unit + integration tests across all work packages; `cargo nextest run -p raul --no-fail-fast`, `cargo clippy -p raul --tests --no-deps -- -D warnings`, `cargo fmt --all -- --check` all green.
AGENT-READINESS.md updated where commands/keys surface changes (no new commands, but a few removed keybinds).
out_of_scope: Internal vocabulary rename (`Lane` enum, `path_lanes_schema.json`, `lane_names` JSON field, code/doc comments stay 'lane') — `mp`-coupled, separate decision.
Esc on top-level list quitting the app — separate behavior change if anyone wants it.

Modifying `compute_progress_bar` itself or the existing `tui_progress.rs` integration test — they stay orthogonal in case a future consumer relies on the string form; deletion is a follow-up decision.

`ratatui::widgets::Scrollbar` migration (replacing the homerolled `tui/render/scrollbar.rs` + `SCROLLBAR_GUTTER` machinery) — deferred to a follow-up track; the gutter math / hit-test integration with `view.scrollbar_rects` is deeper than this milestone.
Co-Approval screen, Annotation Thread body (when not in list form), Backlog Detail rendering — different code paths, separate decisions.
Writable TUI actions from any of the new fields (no editing fields from inside raul).
Section iconography beyond `✦` for section headers and `◆` for the title bar — additional glyph vocabulary deferred.
An 'export milestone detail to markdown' command — adjacent feature, not part of 'show it well in the TUI'.

Per-step / per-finding drill-down via a new TUI overlay (e.g. press Enter on a finding to see the full thread) — the milestone detail view is read-only display by design; full-text / thread-rendering stays on `mp finding show` / `mp reviews finding list` for now.
Mouse-wheel or track-pad handlers in the detail view (PageUp / PageDown / arrow-key navigation is enough; mouse handlers can come later).
New keybinds for review-menu / annotation-thread (these keep their existing single-letter shortcuts).

design_decisions.choice: Add Tab as an additional binding on next_lane, Shift+Tab on previous_lane (multi-binding). Preserve Left / Right / h / l defaults.
design_decisions.rationale: Single field, no new keybind slot, no new conflict diagnostic. Vim users keep muscle memory; upgraders get Tab for free. Config schema unchanged.

design_decisions.choice: Remove entirely. The tab bar is always visual chrome; content is always navigation-ready.
design_decisions.rationale: Two-state model collapses to one observable behavior. Simpler help overlay, simpler footer, simpler Esc, smaller keybind surface.
Preserves RAUL acronym (R/A/U/L-ayers) and matches the visual mental model.

design_decisions.choice: Measurement pass: render the Paragraph into a same-sized Buffer, scan bottom-up for last non-blank row, use as content height for the thumb math.
design_decisions.rationale: Correct regardless of how ratatui wrap / unicode width / ANSI behaves today or in future versions. One small per-paint allocation, dominated by markdown parsing already in the same path.

design_decisions.choice: Markdown-ish headings (`##  ✦  Title  (count)  ──`) parsed via the existing parse_markdown, with thin horizontal rules only between meta blocks and at top/bottom.
design_decisions.rationale: Closest visual fit to a markdown document rendered in a terminal while keeping the grammar terminal-clean (no box-drawing into content rows).

design_decisions.choice: Header + indented context line per item, wrapped/truncated to paragraph interior width.
design_decisions.rationale: Stays compact for narrow terminals and consistent across sections (Steps / ACs / Findings share the same shape).

design_decisions.choice: Flat sorted lists (open-first by severity for findings; Added/Modified/Removed sub-lists for Delta). Rely on the new [/] section-jump keybinds for navigation.
design_decisions.rationale: Collapsed-state tracking is more state for marginal gain; section-jump solves the same 'skip past steps' problem.

design_decisions.choice: Steps rendered FLAT with `wp: WP1` tag on each row whose work_package is set. Work Packages appear as a separate section with goal / rollback.
design_decisions.rationale: n / p next/prev-item works through Steps + ACs + Findings in a single ordered stream — the WP tag is a metadata hint, not a navigation barrier. Section-jump has one Steps target.

design_decisions.choice: ratatui::widgets::LineGauge with filled_style / unfilled_style derived from the ui.icons mode and effective_palette().
design_decisions.rationale: Replaces homemade char-math with a tested, style-aware widget. Honors user preference without a new config surface.

design_decisions.choice: ratatui::widgets::Tabs; compute_tab_bar_layout and tab_hit_test_for_layout in view_state.rs stay (hit-test unchanged).
design_decisions.rationale: Renderer side gets automatic dividers, padding, highlight — but our hit-test/overflow layout is deeply tied together and stays.

design_decisions.choice: List::highlight_style and Table::highlight_style as the single source of truth for selection in their respective widgets; drop the per-item / per-row styling shadowed by it.
design_decisions.rationale: Consistent chrome, less code per overlay, no regressions to selection visuals (one style resolution path vs two).

design_decisions.choice: Drop bg(Color::DarkGray) and BorderType::Double; use Borders::ALL with no fill, matching the milestone detail block.
design_decisions.rationale: Removes the 'floating' feel and aligns chrome with the rest of the TUI.
